extracted.intended_audience: students, teachers, and competitors interested in olympiad geometry problems (CMO and other contests)
extracted.subtask_description: A curated listing of geometry problems from the Chinese Mathematical Olympiad (CMO) covering 1986–2022, with links to AoPS threads, PDFs and related contest collections; also includes a large index of other national, regional and contest problem collections and resources. The page is a resource/aggregation rather than a guideline or evaluation rubric.
